description: The first READ fails with an invalid-request response, which has no two-character batch equivalent, so the read error is reported under the '9' permanent-error convention with image '9000'. The pairing with case09 is the point: the open and the read reach the same 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS paragraph and must render an identical image for an identical status, while their preceding DISPLAY differs - 'ERROR OPENING CARDFILE' at app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:129 against 'ERROR READING CARDFILE' at :110. Both abend with RETURN-CODE 12 from :101 and :124 respectively. Sixteen emission sites across this estate share that one status renderer, and one implementation is what keeps all sixteen byte-identical.
